priorityList: Maintain Agony on your target at all times, ensuring it is refreshed just before summoning your Darkglare.
Maintain Wither on your target at all times.
Cast Dark Harvest on cooldown, provided your primary DoTs (Agony and Wither) are active.
Cast Unstable Affliction while Summon Darkglare or Malevolence is active to maximize burst damage.
Cast Unstable Affliction to avoid reaching maximum Soul Shards (5).
Cast Unstable Affliction if Shard Instability is active or if the Cascading Calamity buff is about to expire.
Use Nightfall procs for Drain Soul (or Shadow Bolt) immediately if you reach maximum stacks (2).
Channel Malefic Grasp as your primary filler while Summon Darkglare is active.
Channel Drain Soul (or cast Shadow Bolt) as your primary filler during all other windows.
Use offensive trinkets and racial abilities (like Berserking or Blood Fury) during your Summon Darkglare window.
